about: From buzzer-beaters to body slams, the NBA 2K26 x WWE 2K25 Bundle is bringing the best of both worlds into one arena that’s yours to control.
Rise up in NBA 2K26 and prove you’ve got what it takes to own the court.

With gameplay, powered by ProPLAY™*, bringing authenticity to every jumpshot, slam, crossover, steal, and block, you can ball out with today’s brightest stars, clash with all-time legends, or chase rings and pursue greatness in MyCAREER…
Step into the squared circle with WWE 2K25, celebrating the past, present, and future of WWE.
Throw down with Legends like “Stone Cold” Steve Austin and The Undertaker or go up against today’s biggest Superstars including Roman Reigns, Bianca Belair, and “The American Nightmare” Cody Rhodes.
With next-level visuals, electrifying entrances, and heart-racing match types, WWE 2K25 brings the greatest, most immersive level of sports entertainment right to your console.
summary: Bragging rights are on the line in MyCAREER, MyTEAM, MyNBA, The W, and Play Now. Showcase your bag of moves with hyper realism, Powered by ProPLAY™, and challenge your friends, or rivals, in NBA 2K26’s competitive modes—and leave no doubt…
